styleLock: Soft watercolor storybook illustration, warm cream paper, gentle washes and fine ink outlines, cozy and tender, warm light. Dad is a tall man in a rust-orange sweater with dark hair. His daughter is small with a sunny yellow bow in her hair. No text, no letters, no words, no watermark.

scenes.name: wall
scenes.vo: One photo hangs in our hallway.
scenes.art: a framed photo of a dad holding his small daughter with a heart above them hangs on a warm hallway wall

scenes.name: newborn
scenes.art: dad cradling a swaddled newborn baby in a warm nursery, tender

scenes.name: steps
scenes.vo: The day she walked to him.
scenes.art: dad kneeling with arms outstretched, a small toddler taking her first wobbly steps toward him

scenes.name: bike

scenes.name: storm
